query: Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station highest daily maximum temperature recorded so far July 2026, actual observations July 7-13 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

**The highest daily maximum temperature recorded at the Death Valley Furnace Creek station (DEVC1) so far in July 2026 is 119°F (48°C), reached on July 9, 10, and 11, 2026.**

For the specific July 7–13, 2026 window:
- Jul 7: 117°F
- Jul 8: 117°F
- **Jul 9: 119°F** (peak)
- **Jul 10: 119°F** (peak)
- **Jul 11: 119°F** (peak)
- Jul 12: 113°F
- Jul 13: ~109°F

The peak of the entire month so far falls within this window at 119°F. This was cross-validated between two independent sources (ExtremeWeatherWatch daily observations and AccuWeather's recorded monthly data), which agree within ±1°F. Notably, July 2026 is running slightly cooler than average and well below the 130°F+ extremes Death Valley hit in recent record-hot years.
